narratives.Description: Restore Vitest branch coverage to at least 85% after the v0.82.0 hairline miss (84.97%). Clear the allow-coverage-debt citation so the next release does not soft-pass again.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary
v0.82.0 release preflight measured Vitest branch coverage at **84.97%** (threshold 85%, ~9 branches short) after adding `evaluateSkillExternalFetchGate` fixture tests. Use this issue as the `--allow-coverage-debt` citation for the cut, then clear the debt in a follow-up patch (same pattern as #2666 / #2618).

## Acceptance
- [ ] Measured Vitest `branches` >= 85% on win32 and Linux without `--allow-coverage-debt`
- [ ] No consecutive soft-pass on the next release after this debt is cited

Refs #2573 #1184

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-07-22T14:21:32Z)

Cited by the v0.82.0 release Step-5 soft-pass (`--allow-coverage-debt=2762`). Measured branches were 84.97% on win32 (threshold 85%). Follow-up patch should restore real coverage without consecutive soft-pass on the next cut.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Inspect uncovered branches around the evaluateSkillExternalFetchGate module under packages/core/src and add focused fixture tests. 2) Re-run coverage and verify Vitest branches reports >=85% without --allow-coverage-debt on win32 and Linux.
narratives.UserStory: As a release operator, I want Vitest branches coverage back at or above 85%, so that the next release does not need another coverage-debt soft-pass.
